subject: BrightPath pilot: quota uplift request + safe-fallback plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-06-10 08:12 -0700
Subject: BrightPath pilot: quota uplift request + safe-fallback plan

Team —

BrightPath is moving their pilot to GA-like traffic for week 1 starting 2028-06-20 and theyve shared an updated hourly cadence (attached). They expect a spike to ~1.2M tokens/hour at peak and sustained 300-400k tokens/hour otherwise. Sales asked for a temporary quota uplift to support the pilot.

Asks:
- Sales: Can we provision a temporary quota bump for BP-47 (details in the XLS)? They want 2x baseline throughput for 48 hours around the peak day.
- Product: We need a short decision on model fallback policy. If the full r8 model hits capacity, do we route to r6-medium (faster) or to a quantized r8-compat variant? See attached fallback_variant_matrix.md for trade-offs.
- Infra: Connor — what are constraints on per-customer soft limits and can we attach a canary window + progressive ramp?

Risk notes:
- Billing/entitlement: This is within the pilot budget but we need a record for post-mortem.
- SLA: Theyre asking for a 99.9% token throughput guarantee for the peak window; we should be explicit about what we can commit to.

I've attached the BrightPath forecast and a proposed fallback matrix. Please reply with clear yes/no and any required mitigation steps by EOD tomorrow (2028-06-11). If we need a quick sync, Elena on their side is available for a 15-min call.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-06-10 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath pilot: quota uplift request + safe-fallback plan

Karthik —

Numbers from commercial: BrightPath will cover overage for the 48h spike but wants confirmation of no hard throttles during the window. The pilot contract (BP-47) allows a temporary uplift with a signed amendment (I can own the DocuSign).

Quick facts:
- Baseline committed tokens/hour: 400k
- Requested peak allowance: 1.2M tokens/hour (2x baseline + safety buffer) for a single 48h window starting 2028-06-21 00:00 UTC
- Billing: apply pilot uplift code, create an invoice line item; I will attach the amendment draft to HubSpot after we confirm technical feasibility.

Next steps I propose:
1) Infra confirms temporary quota change + canary policy.
2) Product confirms fallback variant and whether quality/SLO guardrails are acceptable.
3) I send amendment and schedule a 15-min ops sync with BrightPath.

Marissa
Senior Sales Ops
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-10 13:20 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath pilot: quota uplift request + safe-fallback plan

Thanks for the context. A few product clarifications and asks:

1) Fallback behavior:
- Preferred: route to r8-quant (quantized r8-compat) with a strict warning header to the app when quality degradation > 2% (we can detect with the existing regression hooks).
- Alternate: if quantized variant is not available, fall back to r6-medium but enforce token-length caps to avoid long-tail cost spikes.

2) Pinning: we need to pin the pilot to model version r8-20280529 for the entire 48h window to ensure reproducibility for post-launch analysis.

3) Metrics hooks: add a short-lived eval set (5 prompts) to be run every 30 minutes during the 48h window and push quality alerts to the Launch dashboard. If quality degrades beyond threshold, auto-slow traffic by 20% and page product owners.

Constraints: we cannot guarantee quantized r8-compat availability in all regions; Connor, need confirmation for us-east-1 availability and whether quantized builds are pre-warmed.

I attached the fallback_variant_matrix.md with rationale. If everyone agrees, product can sign-off by EOD 2028-06-11.

—Monica
Senior Product Manager, Serving
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-11 09:47 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath pilot: quota uplift request + safe-fallback plan

Quick infra readout:

- Short answer: we can do a temporary soft quota uplift for BP-47 for the 48h window. Needs two things from product/sales to proceed:
  1) Exact UTC start/end timestamps (Marissa confirmed provisional start 2028-06-21 00:00 UTC).
  2) A traffic smoothing schedule (ramp up / ramp down) with minute-level maxima. We cannot safely flip a 0->1.2M tokens/hr switch without a 6-hr ramp.

- Quantized r8-compat: we have pre-warmed in us-east-1 but not in us-west-2. If BrightPath's traffic will come from multi-region, we recommend routing by geo to us-east-1 for peak traffic.

- Runbook / canary: linked runbook handles temporary policy changes and rollback. I need an on-call owner and an escalation list during the window.

Actions I will take after sign-off:
- Create temporary soft-rate policy and timebox it.
- Pre-warm X nodes with quantized r8 images in us-east-1.
- Add a throttling guard (20% traffic slow) tied to quality alerts or GPU memory pressure above 85%.

Connor
Head of Infrastructure
Attachments: N/A

Thanks — this looks good to us. Quick clarifications from BrightPath:

- Primary traffic will be us-east-1, with a small percentage (~10%) from EU that we can route later.
- We accept a 6-hour ramp and the short canary checks.
- For pinning: were okay with r8-20280529 for the pilot; please confirm that the header/warning will be surfaced if fallback engages.

We are ready for the 15-min ops sync tomorrow 2028-06-13 at 09:00 UTC. If you can send a calendar invite and the DocuSign amendment Marissa mentioned, well sign and return.

Best,
Elena Morales
